subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Teams non-personal Graph media fallback be automatic, default-off behind `channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback`, or split between the existing channel repair and a narrower group-chat opt-in?
rationale: The code fix is bounded, but the default affects Graph call volume, permission expectations, diagnostics, config surface, and the prior mention-only false-positive protection.

options.title: Sequence the existing fixes
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 or an equivalent channel repair, then land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096 only after its group-chat scope and config tradeoff are accepted.

options.title: Fold into one repair
options.body: Ask for one combined Teams media PR that handles channel GUIDs, reply URLs, group-chat missing attachment IDs, and the fallback default together.

options.title: Choose automatic fallback
options.body: Accept the no-new-config direction and close or pause the default-off config PR if maintainers prefer automatic recovery despite extra Graph lookups.

recommendation.title: Sequence the existing fixes
recommendation.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 or an equivalent channel repair, then land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096 only after its group-chat scope and config tradeoff are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is a product/config default decision on a plugin surface where this history shows the strongest central ownership signal.
